query: The Chair That Follows The Artifice homework is to animate something and live with it for a day. You pick a chair, which follows you to every lecture. The teapot is the other option. It has opinions about being carried. Live with the chair The chair follows you everywhere and offers itself whenever you stop, including on the stairs, at speed. By evening you have bruised shins and a very loyal chair. Animate the teapot instead The teapot waddles after you all day, pouring when you sit. It takes more out of you than the chair would, but your friends have never been so well looked after.
